name: collectionFilter
description: This function creates a new collection that returns all entries from an collection that match the given filter.
syntax: collectionFilter( object collection, function filter, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: filter
params.description: filter can be a function/closure that implements the following constructor [function(... depending on given collection ...):boolean].

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
